items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: Oh, myself, Rene, probably they call it Sport, that's Young.

ctx.x: Yeah, it's a gypsy dance they call it. You see, you start at 8 o'clock and you just continue. Piece after piece till 3 o'clock, 4 o'clock, 5 o'clock, 6 o'clock in the morning. I've come out that place sometimes 7 o'clock in the morning. Just continues to play all night, don't stop. The only time you stop for your lunch. And then the saxophone player, he got to stay there and play all the melody. Then when Rene would come back, the saxophone player would go eat. When the saxophone player would come back, the…
Yeah. Who else was in Kid Rene's band on that job, can you remember?
Oh, myself, Rene, probably they call it Sport, that's Young.
